decisions.subject: Pipeline for editing 282 personal US-trip clips into a single video

options_considered.label: Cinematic (mood-led trailer/montage pipeline)
options_considered.reason: Best fit for a single polished highlight reel from real source footage.

options_considered.label: Hybrid (source footage + generated support)
options_considered.reason: Fits documentary-style edits with narration/support graphics.
options_considered.rejected_because: User wants a highlight reel, not a documentary with generated support graphics.

options_considered.label: Clip-factory (many short clips from one source)
options_considered.reason: Fits producing multiple short social clips.
options_considered.rejected_because: User wants one highlight reel, not multiple derivative clips.

decisions.reason: User explicitly chose 'One highlight reel' output type.

decisions.subject: Cinematic concept direction

options_considered.label: Epic Build — Momentum Across America
options_considered.reason: Matches genre-standard 'epic cinematic travel' convention and user's stated mood directly.

options_considered.label: Quiet Wonder — Contemplative Vista
options_considered.reason: Different emotional register (stillness), still within epic territory.
options_considered.rejected_because: User preferred the faster, more propulsive direction.

options_considered.label: Chapters Across America — Journey Structure
options_considered.reason: Best structural fit for a 7-week multi-stop trip.
options_considered.rejected_because: User preferred continuous momentum over chaptered structure.

decisions.reason: User directly selected 'Epic Build' when presented with all three options.

decisions.subject: Composition runtime for the cinematic edit

options_considered.label: Remotion
options_considered.reason: Video-led composition with <OffthreadVideo>, color-grade overlays, letterbox and title-card support over real source footage — matches this brief's video-led delivery promise.

options_considered.label: HyperFrames
options_considered.reason: Strong for HTML/GSAP kinetic typography and launch-reel style motion.
options_considered.rejected_because: Not built around grading/compositing real source video as the primary layer, which is the core of this brief.

options_considered.label: FFmpeg only
options_considered.rejected_because: Would not support color-grade overlays, letterbox reveal treatment, or title cards needed for the epic-cinematic treatment.

decisions.reason: Both Remotion and HyperFrames were presented per the governance HARD RULE; user explicitly approved Remotion given the video-led nature of the piece.

decisions.subject: Music sourcing for the highlight reel

options_considered.label: User music library (music_library/)
options_considered.reason: Folder does not exist / no tracks present.

options_considered.label: Pixabay stock music search
options_considered.reason: Free, available now, well-suited to 'epic cinematic' mood tagging.

options_considered.label: User provides own track
options_considered.reason: Viable but requires the user to source and drop a file first.
options_considered.rejected_because: User preferred the faster Pixabay search path.

decisions.reason: User chose 'Search Pixabay for a track' when presented with the music plan options.

decisions.subject: Target runtime vs. documented YouTube retention drop-off at 2-3 minutes

options_considered.label: Keep 2-3 minutes
options_considered.reason: Trip spans 7 weeks/multiple stops — more room needed to cover it than under-2-minute format allows.

options_considered.label: Tighten to under 2 minutes
options_considered.reason: Best documented retention, but forces cutting most of the trip's stops.

options_considered.label: Extend to 6-8 minutes
options_considered.reason: Better retention than 2-3min middle ground and more room to tell the story, but longer edit effort.

decisions.reason: Retention data point was surfaced explicitly to the user; user chose to keep the original 2-3 minute target given the trip's length and scope.
